# Recommend a paper or correction

推荐新论文时，请提供论文链接和一句收录理由；如果有正式发表页、代码或数据链接，也欢迎一起附上。

- [推荐论文 / Recommend a paper](https://github.com/2-mo/Awesome-Thinking-with-VAD/issues/new?template=paper.yml)
- [纠正内容 / Report a correction](https://github.com/2-mo/Awesome-Thinking-with-VAD/issues/new?template=correction.yml)

For recommendations, share the paper URL and briefly explain its relevance to video anomaly explanation, reasoning, localization or evaluation. For corrections, identify the entry and the proposed change; link supporting evidence if available.

来源核验、数据整理、文档生成和网站发布由维护者完成。感谢帮助完善这个文献集合。

The maintainer handles verification and repository updates. Thank you for helping improve the collection.
